pitches.name: The overhanging face
pitches.beta: No rope: a crash pad and a spotter. Three hard moves, the lightning bolt, the swing and the mantel, on rock polished by everyone in Camp 4.

cruxes.name: The lightning bolt
cruxes.read: Right hand to the bottom of the chalked bolt, drop the left knee to reach up with the left.

cruxes.name: The swing
cruxes.read: Feet cut loose. Let them swing, and hold on with the left until they stop.

cruxes.name: The mantel
cruxes.read: Press both palms on the lip and get a heel up. Everyone falls off here: it's the move that made it famous.
